subject.title: feat(claude): add claude-bridge app-server harness extension

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this as a bundled, foundation-owned Claude harness with a reviewed bridge package, or require the capability to ship as an external plugin/ClawHub integration using existing plugin seams?
rationale: The unresolved decision determines package provenance, whether core auth/runtime changes are appropriate, and whether the branch should be redesigned around an external plugin boundary; this cannot be safely inferred from code quality alone.

options.title: Sponsor a bundled harness redesign
options.body: Adopt a foundation-controlled bridge package and require the PR to remove external dependency bypasses, core-specific ownership, cross-plugin internals, and file-backed runtime state before merge.

options.title: Route it to an external plugin
options.body: Keep core limited to generic documented seams and have the contributor publish the Claude and GLM integrations as externally owned plugin packages.

options.title: Decline this runtime direction
options.body: Close the implementation direction and concentrate Claude investment on existing provider, CLI, or ACP surfaces instead.

recommendation.title: Route it to an external plugin
recommendation.body: Keep core limited to generic documented seams and have the contributor publish the Claude and GLM integrations as externally owned plugin packages.

likelyOwner.reason: The available branch history ties Eddie to the requested Claude session and operator-surface direction, while the canonical issue explicitly asks for maintainer product guidance.
